name: SmileBack CSAT and NPS QBR Summary
description: Building a per-client customer-satisfaction section for a QBR or account review from SmileBack: resolving the client, pulling a quarter of CSAT reviews and NPS responses, computing satisfaction, response rate and NPS with period-over-period change, reading project survey results, picking representative comments, and the sample-size and data-protection caveats that keep the numbers honest.
